title: one toast at a time
name: One toast at a time — Spectrum
rule: One toast at a time — consecutive/simultaneous toasts follow a priority queue; do not stack multiple visible toasts.
pass_when: Only one toast is visible; others wait in a priority queue.
overview: Only one toast is visible; further toasts wait in a priority queue.
apply_when: System confirmations and low-priority alerts after saves or uploads.
not_when: Dialogs that need a response, or sitewide static banners and alerts.
agent_hint: Show one toast at a time; queue the rest by priority instead of stacking.
description: Toast feedback must stay readable: Spectrum allows only one toast on screen while consecutive or simultaneous messages wait in a priority queue. Stacking several visible toasts crowds the viewport and makes status hard to parse. Keep confirmations and simple notifications in that single-toast lane; escalate situations that need attention or a response to a dialog instead of piling more toasts.
